Thanks for testing!

---

Currently, there are 2 gamemodes: Sandbox and Gun Game.

Press 1 and 2 repeatedly to switch between your primaries and secondaries respectively, and press 3 to switch to your knife. 
Press ` or ~ to open console to configure your crosshair and viewmodel. If you have a private server (which are now free) you can also set the gamemode, map etc. Type help to see all commands.
